$comment: A scripted call, for demonstrating live assistance without a telephone.
Replayed by the browser at these delays, so the transcript arrives over the
same WebSocket a transcription service would use and every stage runs for
real — utterance assembly, the pause detector, the actionability
classifier, retrieval and generation. Only the microphone is fake.
It is written to exercise the decisions rather than to flatter them:
The opening lines are a greeting and an address. The classifier should
refuse all of them, and the screen should say so — an assistant that
goes quiet is indistinguishable from one that has crashed.
